newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean forex market closed for Labour day.
newsitem.headline: South Korean forex market closed for Labour day.

text.p: The South Korean foreign exchange market is closed on Thursday for Labour day. The market will open again on Friday.
The won ended higher at 891.90 on Wednesday against Tuesday's closing of 893.00 on expectations of dollar inflows after the May 2 increase in the foreign shareholding limit, dealers said.
The foreign holding limit of Korean stocks will rise to 23 percent from 20 percent on Friday.
